title: Racial addendum (Oct 27): Blood Fury 2 min CD, Berserking 15 s, Touch of the Grave 15 s ICD
claim: A follow-up to the Oct 26 racial pass adds: Orc Blood Fury cooldown 2 min (was 3), Troll Berserking lasts 15 s (was 10), Undead Touch of the Grave internal cooldown 15 s (was 25); Skyborne Charged/Attuned persist through death but are removed on entering a raid.
detail: Kaivax's second post in the development notes thread (#8), listing racials left out of the Oct 26 post. For leveling: Blood Fury is usable on more pulls (every 2 min), Berserking covers longer fights, Touch of the Grave procs more often on long fights. Server-side for launch; not checked in the 70658 client data.

title: New client builds 70630, 70634, 70658 during name reservation (70630 changed 80 data rows)
claim: After 70532, client builds 1.60.1.70630 (80 tracked data rows changed), 70634 and 70658 (no tracked data changes) appeared; 70658 was extracted on Oct 28.
detail: 70630 vs 70532 per Daybreak: 11 item tweaks (e.g. Keen Skinning Knife and Wildgore Greatsword ilvl 19->18, Walton's Second-Favorite Gun 20->18, Bloody Parchment req level 30->1, Encroacher's Claim/Pathfinder's Clearway/Traveler's Shawl blue->green), 39 tooltip changes (Frost Ward, Ice Barrier, Winter's Chill, Missile Barrage, Freezing Trap, Multi-Shot, Eureka!, Elemental Focus, Mana Tide, Dreamfall), 9 new spells (Wind Bridge, Frigid Power, Victory, Dreamfall...), new UI options (Classic/Enhanced turn-strafe keys, Show Quest POIs & Blobs presets). ForeverDB's 70658 vs 70532 diff shows the Oct 20-23 server hotfixes (Mage talents, Righteous Fury at 10) now in client files. Everloot's build watch notes encrypted blocks (Spell 29, QuestV2 5) still hidden. forever-ref has not published 70630+ yet.

title: Datamined 70658: Aspect of the Hawk ranks 1-6 give much less RAP (15/22/30/38/47/55)
claim: Client build 70658 lists Aspect of the Hawk ranged attack power R1 15, R2 22, R3 30, R4 38, R5 47, R6 55 (70532: 20/35/50/70/90, Classic R6 110); rank 7 stays 120.
detail: Same diff: Trueshot Aura RAP bonus lower per rank (30->15 on the base rank; Blizzard's deep dive says new lower-level ranks were added, which may explain part of it), Hunter's Mark rank 4 RAP 71->143, the Explosive Trap Effect spell removed (traps now scale with AP), Survivalist's Discipline proc chance 100% -> none listed. Two independent extractions of the same client data; no patch note yet. Unexplained whether Hawk also gained another effect: check the tooltip in game at 10. Lowers early Hunter ranged DPS while leveling if live.

title: Datamined 70658: Shaman Elemental Focus proc chance 10% -> 100%
claim: ForeverDB's 70658 diff lists the Shaman talent Elemental Focus proc chance changed from 10% to 100% (tooltip also changed in 70630 per Daybreak).
detail: In Classic, Elemental Focus gives a 10% chance after a damaging spell to make the next one free (Clearcasting). A 100% value likely means a new trigger (e.g. on crit, TBC-style) rather than every cast; the exact text isn't published. If it's on crit, it cuts Elemental leveling mana use noticeably. Mana Tide's tooltip also changed. Datamine only.

title: Tauren Plainsrunning stacks drop while a quest dialog is open
claim: Players report that Plainsrunning stacks fall off while an NPC quest dialog is open, so the buff must be rebuilt after reading quest text.
detail: Forum post (Sangrin, Oct 28) and replies describe it from the beta; no measurements. With 2% per stack up to 60% (n:20261027-plainsrunning-60pct-on-foot), each restart costs about 150 s to reach full speed: accept/turn in quickly (or use a quest-accept addon) and avoid stopping mid-run. Verify on day 1.

title: Mage hotfix Oct 20: Elemental Precision 3x2%, Piercing Ice removed, Ice Barrier/Frost Ward up
claim: An unannounced beta hotfix on Oct 20 changed Mage talents: Elemental Precision is 3 ranks of 2% hit (6%, was 5x1%); Piercing Ice (2/4/6% Frost damage) was removed; Ice Barrier rank 1 absorbs 493 (was 448) and adds 3% Frost damage for 1 min plus 3% while it holds; Frost Ward rank 1 absorbs 178 (was 162) plus 10% of Frost spell power; talents were reset.
detail: First reported on r/wowforever (Zipfte) and written up by ForeverDB; ForeverChanges lists the same hotfix with the Ice Barrier/Frost Ward numbers and tree moves (Frost Channeling to column 1, Improved Blizzard to column 2 of row 3; Frost Warding negates instead of reflecting). The beta was down ~20:00 UTC Oct 20 'for hotfixes' (EU forum). Server-side: client files still show the old talents. No Blizzard notes yet. Frost leveling loses Piercing Ice's 6% damage; Ice Barrier becomes a damage buff. Oct 28: client build 70658 now carries these changes (Elemental Precision 3 ranks 2/4/6%, Piercing Ice removed, Frost Warding 15/30% armor+resist and 10/20% negate plus +10/20% Ice Barrier/Frost Ward absorbs, Frost Channeling and Improved Blizzard moved). ForeverDB lists Frost Ward base absorbs unchanged (162 at rank 1) plus 10% of Frost spell power, not 178.

title: Paladin: Righteous Fury learned at level 10 (was 16), hotfix
claim: Righteous Fury is now learned at level 10 instead of 16 (server hotfix on the last beta build, carried into live build 70532).
detail: Read from the public hotfix listing by two independent trackers: foreverchanges.pro (first seen Oct 23) and wowclassicforever.info (Oct 24 entry). Not in Blizzard's notes. Useful for Prot/Ret threat and mana while leveling. Oct 28: the 70658 client data also shows Righteous Fury rank 1 learned/required at level 10 (was 16).
